summary: With B = x⁻¹: ‖B‖² = ‖BB*‖ ≤ 1 + ‖B − BJ₁(𝔰)‖‖B‖, and the columns of B − BJ₁(𝔰) are differences of frame and dual columns of B.

steps.lean: obtain ⟨e, o⟩ := congr(x⁻¹ * $(U.coe_inv IsHermInvolution.mul_self x⁻¹) * 𝔰.J₁), U.one_le_norm x
steps.claim: x = J₁(x⁻¹)ᴴJ₁(𝔰) (x is J₁(𝔰)-unitary and J₁(𝔰)² = 1), which gives e: J₁(𝔰) = x⁻¹J₁(x⁻¹)ᴴ; and o: 1 ≤ ‖x‖.

steps.lean:
simp_all [frameBox, Fin.forall_fin_succ', frameVector, IsHermInvolution.mul_self, ← U.norm_inv,
    ← star_eq_conjTranspose]
steps.claim: Unfold the hypotheses: ‖x⁻¹e_a‖ ≤ M (a < ϱ), ‖x⁻¹z‖ ≤ M and ‖x⁻¹e*_a‖ ≤ M; replace ‖x‖ by ‖B‖ = ‖x⁻¹‖.

steps.lean:
have s (Z : Matrix 𝔰.BesselIndex 𝔰.BesselIndex ℂ) : ‖∑ j, rankOne ℂ (toLp 2 (Z · j))
    (PiLp.single 2 j (1 : ℂ))‖ = ‖Z‖ := congrArg _ (by ext; simp [mulVec_eq_sum, inner])
steps.claim: s: every square matrix Z is the sum over the basis indices j of the rank-one maps (column j of Z) ⊗ e_j, so ‖Σ_j rankOne(Z e_j, e_j)‖ = ‖Z‖.
steps.typed_fact:
‖∑ j, rankOne ℂ (toLp 2 (Z · j))
    (PiLp.single 2 j (1 : ℂ))‖ = ‖Z‖

steps.lean:
grw [← mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ (one_pos.trans_le o), add_mul, ← norm_self_mul_star,
    norm_le_insert', norm_J₁, e, ← mul_assoc, ← sub_mul, norm_mul_le, ← s, norm_sum_le]
steps.claim: Multiplying by ‖B‖ ≥ 1 it suffices that ‖B‖² + ‖B‖ ≤ 8(ϱ+1)M‖B‖. By the C*-identity and e, ‖B‖² = ‖BB*‖ ≤ ‖J₁(𝔰)‖ + ‖BB* − J₁(𝔰)‖ = 1 + ‖B(1 − J₁(𝔰))B*‖ ≤ 1 + ‖B − BJ₁(𝔰)‖‖B‖; write B − BJ₁(𝔰) as the sum of its columns (s) and apply the triangle inequality.

steps.lean: simp [↓norm_rankOne, splitGram, middleGram, mul_apply, ← Pi.sub_def, ← Pi.neg_def]
steps.claim: The columns of B − BJ₁(𝔰): J₁(𝔰) swaps e_a and e*_a, fixes the x_i and negates z, so (B − BJ₁(𝔰))e_j is Be_a − Be*_a, Be*_a − Be_a, 0 or 2Bz according as j = e_a, e*_a, x_i or z.

steps.lean:
grw [norm_sub_le, norm_sub_le, norm_add_le, h.1, h.1, h', h']
  simp; nlinarith [one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le h1 o]
steps.claim: Each column has norm at most 2M, so ‖B − BJ₁(𝔰)‖ ≤ (4ϱ + 2)M, and with 1 ≤ M, 1 ≤ ‖B‖: ‖B‖² + ‖B‖ ≤ 1 + (4ϱ+2)M‖B‖ + ‖B‖ ≤ 8(ϱ+1)M‖B‖ (nlinarith).
